name: go9_scale2000
hypothesis: Training scale is the #1 bottleneck. We have 50K games, reference needed 1M+. 2000 iters × 200 games = 400K games (8x current). Warm-start from se_10ep_rom best checkpoint.
success_criteria: Beat GnuGo Level 1 (>50% in 20 games). If 0% at iter 1000, reconsider approach.

infra_requirements.gpu: A100 80GB preferred (fastest inference + large VRAM). A100 40GB or RTX 4090 acceptable.
infra_requirements.ram: 32GB+ (window buffer of 15 × 200 games × ~50 positions × 8 symmetries ≈ 1.2M positions)
infra_requirements.crash_recovery: CRITICAL — checkpoint_interval=50, resume_from_checkpoint=True. Pod WILL crash in 24-36h. Must be able to restart.
infra_requirements.monitoring: Check loss every 100 iters. If plateau for 200+ iters, notify research agent.
infra_requirements.gnugo_eval: gnugo must be installed on pod. Run eval at iter 500, 1000, 1500, 2000.
infra_requirements.auto_push: Push checkpoints at iter 500, 1000, 1500, 2000 and on completion.

notes: REQUIRES git pull (March 17-18 commits) for C++ ROM fix. This is our first real scale test. Previous experiments maxed at 500 iters × 100 games = 50K games. We're going to 400K.
